children: Presentations to cover updates across Eikon’s clinical pipeline including:

Updated data from TeLuRide-005, an ongoing open-label Phase 2 trial of EIK1001, a TLR7/8 dual-agonist, plus pembrolizumab and histology-appropriate chemotherapy in stage 4 non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
Updated cohort data from an ongoing Phase 1/2 study of EIK1003, a highly selective non-brain penetrant PARP1 inhibitor, as monotherapy and in combination with chemotherapy in advanced solid tumors
Initial data from a Phase 1/2 study of EIK1003 in combination with the novel hormonal agent abiraterone in metastatic prostate cancer
Initial results from an ongoing Phase 1/2 study of EIK1004, a highly selective CNS-penetrant PARP1 inhibitor in advanced solid malignancies
Preliminary safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetic data for EIK1005, a Werner (WRN) helicase inhibitor

(“Eikon”), a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing innovative medicines to address serious unmet medical needs, today announced the publication of full-text abstracts from its four clinical candidates to be presented at the 2026 European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress in Madrid, Spain beginning on October 23, 2026.

“We are looking forward to sharing updates from across our pipeline at ESMO, with seven abstracts highlighting both new clinical findings, and continued progress in our oncology programs,” said Roger M. Perlmutter, M.D., Ph.D., Chief Executive Officer and Board Chair of Eikon. “Eikon scientists and clinicians look forward to discussing these results with the broader oncology community in Spain.”
2026 ESMO Abstract Titles and Presentation Details:
2664P - TeLuRide-005: Phase 2 study of EIK1001 (TLR7/8 dual agonist) plus pembrolizumab and chemotherapy in patients with stage IV NSCLC: results from the squamous cohort and updated pooled results
2724TiP - A Phase 2/3 Study of EIK1001 in Combination with Pembrolizumab and Chemotherapy in Participants with Stage 4 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) [TeLuRide-008]
1048P - Phase 1/2 study of a PARP1-selective inhibitor, EIK1003, as monotherapy and in combination with paclitaxel (PTX) in advanced solid tumors
1049P - Phase 1/2 study of a PARP1-selective inhibitor, EIK1003, in combination with abiraterone in patients with metastatic prostate cancer (mPC)
1060P - A first-in-human Phase 1/2 study of EIK1004, a PARP1-selective CNS-penetrant inhibitor, in patients with advanced solid tumors with HRR mutations
1143eTiP - Phase 1/2 Study of the Novel Werner Helicase Inhibitor EIK1005 as Monotherapy and in Combination with Pembrolizumab in Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors, Including MSI-H or dMMR Tumors
1010P - Analysis of the Safety, Tolerability, and PK of EIK1005, a Novel WRN Inhibitor

Eikon is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company dedicated to building a global, fully-integrated organization developing innovative medicines to address serious unmet medical needs. Eikon’s initial focus is oncology, where it is advancing a pipeline of drug candidates targeting areas of high unmet need that could eventually become critical medicines for the treatment of various cancers. Eikon deploys its technology platform, including its proprietary single molecule tracking system, to develop internally-derived novel therapies, while also leveraging the deep expertise of its management team to in-license promising assets. Eikon’s vision is to become a generational leader, by purposefully integrating traditional biology research with advanced engineering to develop better medicines faster. For more information, visit www.eikontx.com.
